entry.name: Google AI Essentials
entry.note: A course certificate, not a proctored exam; a non-technical introduction to using generative AI at work
entry.audience: Anyone in a non-technical role who wants working fluency with generative AI

covers: Using generative AI tools to develop ideas and content
Using AI responsibly by identifying biases and avoiding harm
Developing strategies to stay up-to-date in AI
Explaining how AI functions at a basic level
Describing capabilities and limitations of AI tools
Recognizing the importance of human oversight
Applying prompting techniques including few-shot prompting
reading.format: Self-paced program with videos, readings, interactive exercises, and hands-on activities.
reading.summary: Google AI Essentials is a self-paced program that teaches how to use generative AI tools for daily work tasks. It covers writing effective prompts, using AI responsibly, and applying AI to generate ideas and content. Completing the program earns a certificate from Google to share with employers and networks.
reading.audience: People across roles and industries who are new to AI and want to speed up daily tasks. No technical experience is required.
reading.prerequisites: Zero experience required; no technical experience needed.
